cases.prompt: Add a settings modal that closes on Escape and respects reduced motion.
must: use the modal recipe with a native dialog element
keep focus inside the dialog and return it to the trigger on close
include the prefers-reduced-motion guard
keep the close transition shorter than the open transition
must_not: make motion the only signal that the dialog opened

cases.prompt: Our account dropdown appears and disappears instantly. Make it feel polished.
must: pick the popover recipe
make the surface origin-aware with a transform-origin that follows the trigger
add a faster exit than entry
preserve light dismiss and keyboard access
must_not: leave the surface mounted without an exit transition

cases.prompt: Show a success confirmation after the user saves a document.
must: use the success-check recipe
include visible text and a live status region
make the check path draw measurable at runtime or with a verified dasharray
keep the confirmation announced to assistive technology
must_not: rely on the checkmark animation as the only signal

cases.prompt: Make every transition in the app 20% faster without touching each component.
must: set --mf-scale once on :root
explain that durations derive from the scale multiplier

cases.prompt: Port the tabs transition from our React component to Svelte.
must: reuse the same CSS classes and tokens
keep the same ARIA roles and keyboard behavior
keep the sliding indicator measured without animating on first paint

cases.prompt: Audit the animations in src/ and tell me what to fix. Do not change anything.
must: run the bundled audit script or apply its rules
group findings by file with line numbers
explain each finding and the suggested recipe

cases.prompt: Our accordion leaves a thin strip when it closes. Fix it.
must: move padding to the inner panel
keep the grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr technique
keep the closed content inert and aria-hidden
must_not: animate height with a fixed pixel value

cases.prompt: Animate navigation between a list and a detail page, with a fallback.
must: use the page-slide recipe
use the View Transitions API when available
provide an instant fallback when unsupported or when motion is reduced
move focus to the new view heading
must_not: block keyboard navigation while the animation runs

cases.prompt: Add a toast for a background upload and respect the user's motion setting.
must: use role=status and aria-live=polite
pause auto-dismiss on hover and focus
skip translation but keep a short opacity change under reduced motion

cases.prompt: Add a bouncy spring animation to our command palette that opens hundreds of times a day.
must: explain the frequency gate
offer a near-instant fade or no animation instead
must_not: add a spring or scale animation to a keyboard-first surface
